description: This file defines composable UI components for tabs in an Android app, including individual tabs (NiaTab), a tab row (NiaTabRow), and a preview function. It also includes default styling parameters.

classes.name: NiaTabDefaults
classes.description: Object holding default styling parameters for tabs, such as top padding.

methods.name: NiaTab
methods.description: Composable function that creates a styled tab with centered label, wrapping Material 3 Tab.

methods.name: NiaTabRow
methods.description: Composable function that creates a row of tabs with an indicator, wrapping Material 3 TabRow.

methods.name: TabsPreview
methods.description: Preview composable demonstrating the usage of NiaTabRow with sample tabs.
